Container.Name: planhaven
Container.Overview: Self-hosted project manager for home, vehicle and maker projects: from idea to done. Tasks, lists, notes, sharing with your household, iPhone-friendly web app. Built to be exposed to the internet: mandatory second factor (passkeys or authenticator app), row-level security, signed images.[br][br]A reverse proxy with HTTPS (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager) is REQUIRED for internet use. Set BASE_URL to your public https address and TRUSTED_PROXIES to your proxy's address. On first start, the container log shows a one-time setup token for creating the admin account.[br][br]Back up /config/secrets separately: see docs/backup-restore.md.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: PlanHaven's web port. Point your reverse proxy here; don't expose it to the internet directly.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, keys, backups and logs. Keep on a fast disk (cache/pool).

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: Your public address, exactly as you type it in the browser, e.g. https://projects.example.com (must be https).

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: IP address or network of your reverse proxy, e.g. 172.18.0.0/16 for a Docker network. PlanHaven only believes client addresses forwarded by these.

Config.Name: ADMIN_ALLOWED_CIDRS
Config.Description: Optional. Your home network, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24: the admin area is then invisible from anywhere else.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Your time zone, e.g. America/New_York, for reminders and the nightly backup (03:00).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for files the app writes.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for files the app writes.
